items.title: Catherine Russell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 26, 2018
items.q: I was able to, you know Larry Campbell, who produced that album is a multi-instrumentalist obviously, and I was able to guide him in a violin line that I wanted him to play you know.

ctx.x: Are you glad that you learned to play the guitar and the mandolin and all that? Does it inform your singing?

Well I won’t say that I learned. I’m very self-taught on everything. But yeah, I mean all of that knowledge, as much as I have instrumentally, informs what I want to hear around me. It informs me what I can ask musicians to play in certain instances. You know, I’d like this, you know, “How about a single note here instead of the whole chord, how about” — so that we can discuss what we like and mutually come up with something. So it helps me to also, like at one point, I think it was the second album. I was able…
Yeah. So you can find out where you fit.
